methodology.flow: exact same synthesis command as the shipped bitstream (scripts/fpga-build.sh)
methodology.note: Vivado unavailable (AMD account login required); counts come from the identical open-source synthesis flow that produced the shipped .bit

shipped_bitstream_ternary_mac_demo_top.finding: The shipped demo bitstream lets synthesis PRUNE the 32-bit accumulator to the 2 bits observed by the LEDs: w_code is constant +1 and acc_in is constant 0, so acc_out reduces to a. The shipped bitstream therefore does NOT exercise the full ternary MAC datapath.

full_mac_probe_ternary_mac_full_observe.purpose: XOR-reduce all 32 accumulator bits so the complete ternary MAC datapath survives synthesis; w_code varies over {+1,0,-1}
full_mac_probe_ternary_mac_full_observe.note: 19 LUT1 + 4 INV are the ring-oscillator clock; the ternary MAC itself costs 13 LUTs (2xLUT3 + 7xLUT4 + 4xLUT6), 5 CARRY4 chains and part of the 17 FFs.

power_estimate.method: not_yosys_derived; Vivado report_power unavailable (AMD account login required)
power_estimate.note: Honest bound: with 0 DSP and 0 BRAM in use and only 32 LUTs active, total board power is dominated by static/IO/clock, not the MAC datapath.

j_per_token.note: Requires Vivado report_power (or external meter) for MEASURED value
